text: Whitebeard's Encampment is small camp site located in central Coldridge Valley.
Whitespire refers to a highborne family of Arcane reforgers.
__NOTOC__ Whispering Blue Stones drop from Kurzen Headshrinker in the Stockpile in Northern Stranglethorn.
The Whisperwind Robes drop from the Echo of Tyrande in the End Time.

The White Tiger clan was a concepted strong military pandaren shao'din living in Kun-Lai Summit in northern Pandaria. The White Tiger of the North was their animal aspect. During the development of Mists of Pandaria, they evolved into the unnamed members of the Temple of the White Tiger.

Whittler Dewei is a pandaren profession trainer and vendor found in the Singing Pools on the Wandering Isle. Similarly to Elder Oakpaw, he can train the player every profession in the game, to the usual limit of two.
Whitefeather Cranes can be found in the Singing Pools on the Wandering Isle. They are normally neutral, but will attack players with the Curses of the Frog and Turtle.
Whisperwind Protectors are ancient protectors that stand in defense of Whisperwind Grove in Felwood. While they are attackable, it's generally not a good idea to try fighting them.
White Seedlings are orchids located in the Botanica. They are summoned by High Botanist Freywinn.
Whitefisher Cranes are found in the Singing Marshes in Valley of the Four Winds and Deepwild in Krasarang Wilds.

Whispercloud Rise is the northern end of the Path of Conquerors in northeast Kun-Lai Summit, overlooking the Zouchin Province, far below. Shin Whispercloud provides his balloon to ferry travelers from the rise down to the province.
White Orchid is a pandaren found sparring with Crimson Peony at the Jade Temple Grounds in the Jade Forest.
Whitepetal Reeds line Whitepetal Lake and the small river that feeds it in central Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Whitefisher Crane Eggs can be found on the open ground of the Singing Marshes of the Valley of the Four Winds.
White Chickens are chicken critters found in Orgrimmar, Ruins of Gilneas, and Valley of the Four Winds.
Whitefin is a rare murloc located west of The Loch. He appears to be the leader of the murlocs in Loch Modan.
White Tiger Battlegear is the tier 14 retribution paladin set.
White Turnip Seeds are purchased from for in the Halfhill Market. It can be planted at Sunsong Ranch to grow a White Turnip. Seeds can also rarely be found while harvesting at the farm.
__NOTOC__ White Turnips are a cooking ingredient. They can be found on any yaungol on Pandaria as well as grown at Sunsong Ranch from White Turnip Seeds. They apparently have a spicy flavor.
__NOTOC__ Whitemane's Embroidered Chapeau drops from High Inquisitor Whitemane in Scarlet Monastery.
White Trillium Ore can be found in Trillium and Rich Trillium veins in all zones of Pandaria. When combined with equal parts Black Trillium Ore, the white ore can be smelted to form Trillium Bars.
The Whistle of Chromatic Bone drops from Chromaggus in Blackwing Lair.
Who's Got Two Green Thumbs? is an achievement that is awarded for defeating Tsulong in the Terrace of Endless Spring raid instance while keeping the Enchanted Plant alive.

The Whispering Inlet surrounds Shaol'mara / Violet Rise on the southeastern side of the Isle of Thunder. Before the Alliance takes Shaol'mara, a troll ship is anchored in the area at in the open waters.
Whirl Turtles are dragon turtles located in the Lair of Tortos in the Throne of Thunder during the Tortos encounter.
Whole-Body Shrinka is purchased from Ravika in Echo Isles for .
Whizzig, the merchant of time, riding his noble "steed" Slimy, will randomly appear at one of the four corners of the Celestial Court selling vanity pet items.
Whispershade Hollow lies at the bottom of the valley formed by the Firewalkers' Path high above on three sides, and the greater Red Stone Run to the south. Several Timewalkers have set up camp here.

Why Do We Fight? wraps up the Mists of Pandaria storyline, with the reward being a cutscene between the player, Lorewalker Cho, Emperor Shaohao, and the August Celestials. This cutscene can be replayed by interacting with the Wisdom of the Emperor object next to Cho in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Completing this quest also unlocks the objects Memory of the Alliance and Memory of the Horde (the nearby stone pillars), which will replay the respective faction cutscenes for the end of Siege of Orgrimmar.
Whisperwind Healers are secretly satyr disguised as tauren and night elves located at Jadefire Run in Felwood.

Whitefeather is the hawk pet of Hawkmaster Nurong, and can be found accompanying him at several locations throughout Townlong Steppes. She followed her master on the Isle of Thunder, and on the Timeless Isle. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Whitefeather was accompanying Nurong in the Terrace of Endless Spring.
The White Kraken is an imaginary creature mentioned by the fake Captain Ironbeard in Ironfist Harbor in . * *
Whitefang is 's wolf companion that accompanies her in her journey throughout , at the Altar of Kron in Frostfire Ridge, the Gorgrond Pass and Beastwatch in Gorgrond and the Stones of Prophecy in .
The White Murlog Egg item teaches you to summon Terky, a white baby murloc companion. Terky is notable for being the only baby murloc companion available to players outside of special promotions.
The Whitewater Tsunami dropped from the Whitewater Typhoon in Stormheim.
The Whitewater Froth was a quest reward from Crystal Fury (quest).
The Whitewater Typhoon can be found in the Weeping Bluffs in Stormheim.
The Whitewater Tempests can be found in the Weeping Bluffs in Stormheim.
Whisper of the Nathrezim enhances Templar's Verdict and Divine Storm.
The Whispers in the Dark can be found inside Gift of the Nightborne after defeating Gul'dan in the Nighthold.

Whispering Bluffs is a large open grove found in southern Val'sharah. Tiris Rainshadow and Lorel Sagefeather aim to protect the Pygmy Owls of the area from the murderous Gorebeak. There are multiple elven houses located in the area, including the dwelling of Silbermana Dawncap.
Whisperwind's Citadel is a warden tower found in northern Stormheim.
Wholesome Hostesses are banshees located in the Guest Chambers in the Return to Karazhan. They are disguised as blood elves, but their real appearance is revealed when they are hurt enough.
__NOTOC__ White Lightningsteel is used by blacksmiths to create the Godfighter Hammer.
Whispers of Shaohao is a Mistweaver monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Effusive Mists and Concordance of the Legionfall traits.
Whiskey Tango Foxtrot is the pet of Drupala Nearmiss located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Whispering Totem is a reward from Thunderaan's Enemies: Tulmos.
Wick is a goblin who is a patron of the Hearthstone Inn. He is the brother of Fewz. They often provide commentary, whether requested or not, for the tavern’s heated Hearthstone matches.
This item was used to summon Ar'lia of the Moro'gai faction.
Whirlwind's Harvest drops from Windcaller Korast at the Stones of Prophecy in .
Why Male(volent) Models? is about collecting a full set of Season 12 armor (including bracer, belt and boots) for one class.
Whompus is a yeti located in Whompus' Lair in Tiragarde Sound.
:For the TCG cards, see Whiteout (Icecrown), Whiteout (Assault on Icecrown Citadel), and Whiteout (Champion Deck: Jaina). Whiteout is an Azerite trait available to Frost mages.
Whistlebloom Juicy Fruits are looted from the objects of the same name in Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun.
White Tortollans are sold by Master Talekeeps in the following dive bars for :
Whispertail is a cloud serpent pet of Whispering Pandaren Spirit located in Jade Forest.
Whisperfen Chopper is a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
Whisperfen Hewer is a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
Whirling Dervish Sash drops from Adderis and Aspix in the Temple of Sethraliss.
Whiskey Stevo is a goblin located at the Downrange: Bar, Grill, and Minefield in the MOTHERLODE!!
Whizbang the Wonderful is a gnome from the prestigious Westfall Wonderfuls.
__NOTOC__ Whistlebloom Hunters are saurolisks located on the ridges around Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun. Some are seen eating dead Zandalari Exiles.
__NOTOC__ Whistlebloom Hatchlings are juvenile saurolisks located on the ridges around Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun.
Whistlebloom Sentries are wasps located in Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun.
The Whitegrove Pale Ale is sold by innkeepers and bartenders in Kul Tiras.
Whistlebloom Impalers are wasps that periodically approach the central pool in Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun before being driven off by the Defiant Riverbeast.

The Whistlebloom Oasis is nestled in a gorge immediately northwest of Atul'Aman in central Vol'dun. Wasps inhabit the oasis itself, while saurolisks roam the surrounding ridges and like to pounce on targets below. A few riverbeasts are found in the oasis' central pool, along with the tablet Tales of de Loa: Akunda. The Goldtusk Inn is nestled in a cave on the northeast side of the oasis.
Whomper is a wandering young wendigo from the snowy passes of Drustvar.
Whispering Seawitch's Ring is a quest reward from Beneath the Waves.
Whispering Horror is an eye stalk located at the Sundered Temple in Zuldazar. It has seemingly been summoned by Summoner Siavass.
Who is a wolf located on the second floor of Ruff Waters in Boralus.
Whirlwing's Plumage drops from Whirlwing in Stormsong Valley.
__NOTOC__ Whitney "Steelclaw" Ramsay is a human located at the Crimson Coast in Drustvar.
The Whitewater Cinch is a quest reward from Wrathshard (quest).
The Whitewater Legwraps are a quest reward from Wrathshard (quest).
The Whitewater Safety Blanket is a quest reward from Moozy's Adventure.
The Whitewater Gloves are a reward from the following quests: *Spray and Prey *Moozy's Adventure
The Snowblind Raiment is a quest reward from Spray and Prey.
The Whitewater Leggings are a quest reward from Rite of Blood.
The Whitewater Wristguards are a quest reward from Dargrul and the Hammer.

Whispering Wavestaves are staves found in Port Fogtide in Stormsong Valley. Interacting with a staff provides the Whispers from Below buff granting a 10% increase to damage dealt and 600 leech but reduces max health by 20%.
The Whitewater Headguard is a quest reward from The Underking.
The Whitewater Sabatons are a quest reward from Ormgul the Pestilent (quest).
White Dragonspawn is an unreleased dragonspawn. It may have been intended to be blue dragonspawn.
__NOTOC__ Whitewave Reefwalkers are coral ancients located in Nazjatar.

Whitegrove Chapel is a small chapel located in northwestern Corlain in Drustvar. It is a popular place for the inhabitants of the region wishing to get married there, as the price for the reservation being very high for hosting weddings, and the time on the waiting list can be long up to more than two years.
Whispers of N'Zoth begins the "On the Trail of the Black Prince" storyline.
Whispering Reef Salvage is bought for from Captain Nightrunner in Boralus and Captain Kitt in Dazar'alor.
Whirling Torrent is an orb located in the Altar of Drowned Whispers in Stormsong Valley.

The Whispering Crag is an area on the northern coast of Vol'dun, encompassing part of the moat around Tortaka Refuge, the dirt road running northwest to the Bouldered Bluffs and the Temple of Kimbul, the cliffs north of the temple, and parts of the northern coast west of the Shrouded Shore.
Whompus' Lair is a location in Tiragarde Sound. It is the lair of Whompus.
Whisperfen Staff is a quest reward from world quests on Zandalar.
__NOTOC__ Whirlpool Seed is a quest reward from Legion world quests or is contained in caches.
Whirling Rebound is an Azerite trait for hunters. It doesn't appear to be available.
Whizzlespark's Portable Pet Mansion was a bag intended to only hold companion pet items. This idea was scratched in favor of the Pet Journal that was introduced with .
Whirly is a sinstone golem located at the Absolution Crypt in Revendreth.
Whitewhisker Tunnel Rat was a kobold located in Alterac Valley.
Whizblast Walking Stick drops from the Manastorms in de Other Side.
Whispers of the Damned is an Azerite trait available to Shadow priests.

The Whispering Hollows are the caverns the connect from Anguish Fortress to the Crypt of the Ancients and from the Crypt to the Pools of Reflection. The second half of the caverns is where Nhallish is found.

Who Sent You? is awarded for killing 100 Assassins or Stygian Abductors in the Maw. At tier 3 of Eye of the Jailer, the Jailer starts spawning Assassins to harry the player. Defeat them (or other players' assassins...) to advance progress on this achievement. If the character has completed Focusing the Eye during the Chains of Domination campaign, the removal of the Eye mechanic made it impossible to complete this achievement solo. The only way to continue this achievement at that point was by party syncing with a character who has not yet completed the quest. In patch 9.1.5, Mawsworn Blackguard mobs were added to the Maw and serve as targets for this achievement, regardless of Korthia quest
Whisperer Vyn is an aranakk of the House of Eyes who plays a prominent role in the :Necrolords Campaign alongside her sister, Navigator Xennir.
Whitewater Gauntlets are a quest reward from Titanic Showdown.

and Tal-Galan.]] Who is the Maw Walker? takes place mid-way through the second chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign. After completing the trial, the Maw Walker's mounts will hear their call once again, allowing them to mount up.

White Razorwing Talon can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 48 Cataloged Research and 24 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.
Whole Pot-Roasted Elekk would have been created with Cooking.
Whisperfen Polearm can be looted from Zandalari Weapons Cache.
Whisperstep Runners drop from Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Wicked Bladewing Pauldrons drop from Stone Legion Generals in Castle Nathria.
Whispering Felflame Crystal dops from the final bosses of Timewalking bosses.
Whitewater Ringmail Cuffs are a quest reward from Tamer Takedown.
Whitesea's Waistwrap drops from Territorial Meadowstomper and Sean Whitesea in Nagrand. It is sold by Tempra in Stormshield and Kronnus in Warspear for .
Whitewater Chestwrap is a quest reward from Can't Hold a Candle To You.
Whitetail Fox Tunic is a quest reward from Foxes and Hounds.
Whipweed Hearts were to be looted from Whipweed plants in Un'Goro Crater.
__NOTOC__ Wholesome Hosts are wraiths disguised as male blood elves in the Guest Chambers in the Return to Karazhan.
The White Gloves is part of the appearance for the "Snowy Owl" Contender's Costume.
The White Boots is part of the appearance for the "Snowy Owl" Contender's Costume.
The White Chest is part of the appearance for the "Snowy Owl" Contender's Costume.
The White Legs is part of the appearance for the "Snowy Owl" Contender's Costume.
The White Helm is part of the appearance for the "Snowy Owl" Contender's Costume.
Whisperdown is a faerie located in Keeper's Respite in Korthia.
Whirlwind Wine is obtained by throwing Kul Tiran Red at a Rampaging Wind in the Waking Shores.
Who's a Good Bakar? is an exploration achievement earned by petting all of the bakar in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
White Bell Pigment is looted from Mature White Bells and Barbed Tulips found in the Waking Shores. Upon pickup, this item immedeately grants 4 - 5 Dragon Isles Supplies.
Wicked-Looking Spears are found in Stormheim and Helheim. When picked up, they can be thrown at enemies.
Whirling Surge is unlocked after earning the An Azure Ally achievement.
Whispering Incarnate Icon drops from the Primal Council encounter in Vault of the Incarnates.
Whistling Rocks becomes available at Renown Level 11 with the Maruuk Centaur.
Whiteclaw is a large frost wolf seated next to Palkar atop a tower in Frostwolf Village in Alterac Valley during A People in Need of Healing.
__NOTOC__ Whirglgurgl is a gorloc located in the Waking Shores.
Whodunnit? is an exploration achievement earned by figuring out each of the fifteen secrets that surfaced during the Secrets of Azeroth event.
Whirling Waveling is a water elemental companion that was never made available. It has the same appearance as the Water Wavelings in Zul'drak.

Widgets are graphical elements created in Lua with () or via XML. Widget objects can be extended with templates, mixins and intrinsics. The user interface may be inspected with /fstack, /tinspect and development addons like [https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/devtool DevTool] and [https://github.com/TekNoLogic/Spew Spew]. Widget_Hierarchy.png|[https://www.townlong-yak.com/framexml/live/UI_shared.xsd UI.xsd], [https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/search?q=ScriptObject Documentation] API_framestack_02.png|/fstack and /tinspect
Wigcik is a goblin fish vendor located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

"A wiki (IPA: <WICK-ee> or <WEE-kee>) is a type of that allows users to easily add, remove, or otherwise edit and change some available content." – from Wikipedia, August 17th, 2006 Wowpedia is a wiki website. Any website based on any kind of wiki software (such as [http://www.mediawiki.org/ MediaWiki], which Wowpedia uses) which enables users to add to, edit, and delete from the site's content quickly is commonly referred to as a "wiki".

Widget scripts allow you to respond to user interaction and other types of widget events (such as a frame being shown or hidden). This page lists the available scripts and the list of widget types for which each script is valid. Wicked Leather Armor is leather chest armor for Rogues or Feral Druids. Its part of the Wicked Leather Set collection.
__NOTOC__ Widow's Remorse is a one-handed sword. Primary for tanks due to the armor, stamina and speed.
Wik'Tar is a jungle troll fishing and fish vendor located at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
__NOTOC__ Wild Bucks are stags found in northwestern Ashenvale.

The Wicked Leather collection is a set of six items which can be crafted by skill level 300 leatherworkers. This is not a true item set, and does not confer any set bonuses. These items are primarily designed for rogues, as they are composed only of Stamina and Agility bonuses. Wicked Leather Gauntlets and Headbands are commonly used by Leatherworkers to skill up from 260 to 300, as they only require the leatherworker to find Rugged Leather.
Wicked Witch's Hat drops from the Crone from the Wizard of Oz encounter in Karazhan.
Wild Fel Stalkers are summoned by Olm the Summoner in Gruul's Lair.
Wild Draenish Boots are created with Leatherworking (300); taught by trainers.
Wild Draenish Gloves are created wit hLeatherworking (310); taught by trainers.
Wild Draenish Leggings are created with Leatherworking (320); taught by trainers.
Wild Draenish Vest is created with Leatherworking (330); taught by trainers.
Wild Draenish Armor is a leather uncommon crafted set from the Burning Crusade. It is crafted by Leatherworking.
Wild Elekks are elekks located throughout Nagrand. __NOTOC__
The Wicked Strong Fetish is provided as an objective for A Curse Upon Both of Your Clans!.
Wide Metal Girdle is a quest reward from From The Wreckage....

The Wicked Grotto is located inside Maraudon, and is the first area beyond the instance portal in the purple tunnels. It stretches past the Vyletongue Seat to the Poison Falls, and is home to numerous satyr and grells. It is a demonically tainted part of the dungeon, showing signs of corruption, darkness, and malice.
Wicker Chests can be found on the ground around Feralfen Village in central Zangarmarsh south of the Twin Spire Ruins.

The Wicked Coil is a small pillar of rock that looks like a coil from above, located just north of Galakrond's Rest in the Dragonblight. The Grand Necrolord Antiok can be found here on top of Thiassi the Lightning Bringer. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Galford passed through here and was attacked by Wastes Scavengers.
Wicked Huge Citrine is a gem crafted by a jewelcrafter from a Huge Citrine.
Wicked Sun Brooch is created by combining an Iron Dwarf Brooch, a Huge Citrine, and a Sun Crystal.
The Wickerman Guardian Ember spawns upon killing a Wickerman Guardian. Clicking it grants the buff Invocation of the Wickerman, which increases experience and reputation gained by 10% for 2 hours.
This item was crafted by Jewelcrafters with a skill level of 390. * This item was learned by Design: Wicked Monarch Topaz.
Wild Carrots are found southwest of the Westfall Brigade Encampment in the Grizzly Hills.

Wiggleweed Sprout is a seaweed growing at the Clutch in Kelp'thar Forest. The plant seems to be food for Zin'jatar naga but will create bowel cramps for humans if they eat too much. The item drops from Shimmerspine Harvesters and Zin'jatar Guardians.
Wild Clucker Eggs is provided by Bamm Megabomb for Trading Up. When used, it summons a Wild Clucker Egg.
Wil'hai is a whale shark found in Abyssal Depths. He is being held by Tentacle Horrors.
on a Wild Clucker.]] Wild Cluckers are critters found around Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.
Wicked Dagger drops from Randolph Moloch in the Stormwind Stockade.
Wild Black Dragon Eggs are found in Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands.
.]] The Widow's Clutch is an area in eastern Molten Front, just north of Forlorn Spire. It's infested with fire spiders.
Wild Charge is a druid class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Tiger Dash.

The Widening Deep was carved out by waters flowing from the Ambermarsh leading to the Westersea to the southwest. The chasm comprises the western half of the border between Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes. The corpses of many a Kor'thik fleetwing litter the area, blasted out of the sky by Shado-Pan defenders at the Farwatch Overlook.

Widow Greenpaw, also known as the Jade Witch, is a pandaren that lives in the Lair of the Jade Witch located in the Forest Heart in the Jade Forest. She is the widow of Master Greenpaw, a master jade crafter and master monk. Although pitied by the adult villagers of nearby Dawn's Blossom, the children believe that she is a witch that turns people into jade statues. The children turn out to be correct, as the widow is indeed turning her visitors into jade statues, which she places in gardens surrounding her house. She also has control over jade cat statues, which fight for her and can turn opponents into jade.
Wild Cloudrunners are cloud serpents located at Shan'ze Dao in the Townlong Steppes. They are being corrupted by Shan'ze Serpentbinders into Shan'ze Cloudrunners.
__NOTOC__ Widow Spiderlings are spiders located in Duskwood.
Wicked Witch's Signet is an ring. Its stats scale to your level when acquired.

The Widow's Wail is a cavern located along the northeastern wall of the Jade Forest, just south of Sri-La Village. The entrance is connected to the Oona Kagu cavern by a bamboo bridge. The cavern itself is infested with spiders which have also been affected by the sha. Members of the Order of the Cloud Serpent have been tasked with clearing out the cave.
Wild Earths are unbound earth elementals located in the Kor'kron elemental camp in Northern Barrens
Wild Crimson Hatchlings are level 25 dragonkin that can be captured for pet battles.
Widow Venom Sacs drop from Black Widows and Black Widow Hatchlings outside of Raven Hill in Duskwood.
Wicked Spirits are level 80 elites located in Icecrown Citadel. They spawn on the Lich King encounter, only on Heroic mode.
__NOTOC__ Widowspawns are bone spiders found in the Widow's Wail in the Jade Forest.

Wiggling Egg is found at in a rylak nest in Grom'gar in southeastern Frostfire Ridge. Access the area by either running atop the snow-covered (eastern) side of the colossal corpse and jumping over the spine onto the highest, snow-covered, tarp. The egg is underneath cover guarded by a Thunderlord Beastmaster. Loot the wiggling egg to gather a Mysterious Egg (Frostfire Ridge) and 10-20x Garrison Resources. Much like the Mysterious Egg of the Oracles in Sholazar Basin, this egg will hatch in 72 real-time hours (3 real-time days) into a Cracked Egg (Frostfire Ridge) which contains the Fruit Hunter pet.
Wika-Wika is a hozen located at the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ Widget the Departed is sold by Chub and Dorothy, the candy and toy vendors of Hallow's End, for .
Wild Gladiator is a title awarded for being the highest rated arena team in the Battlegroup at the end of Warlords Season 2.
Widowsisters can be found in the Circle of Wills in Dalaran. They can be hired from The Widow with a Widowsister Contract.
Wild Conquest is a Legacy achievement earned for accumulating 27,000 Conquest Points in PvP Warlords Season 2.
__NOTOC__ Wild Combatant is a Legacy achievement earned for winning 100 3v3 Arena matches or 40 Rated Battlegrounds in Warlords Season 2.
Wicked Crawlers are spider demons located on the Fel Hammer in Mardum.
Wikket Witch's Hat drops from Opera Hall: Wikket in the Return to Karazhan.
Wild Aspirant's Vestments is the Warlords Season 2 Rogue arena set.
Wild Combatant's Vestments is the Warlords Season 2 Rogue arena set.
Wild Cragscalers are talbuks located in the Petrified Forest in Krokuun. They are sometimes domesticated in used as mounts by the resistance, these are called Darkfallen Cragscaler.
__NOTOC__ Wicked Corruptors are eredar located in Invasion Points.
Wild Combatant's Sanctuary is the Warlords Season 2 Druid arena set.
Wild Clefthooves are clefthooves located in Gorgrond. In , a doomsday weapon was enchanted to look like one of these clefthooves.
Wild Blooms are orchids located throughout Talador. They hide themselves and will not be targetable unless aggroed.
Wild Combatant's Vindication is the Warlords Season 2 paladin arena set.
Wild Combatant's Wartide is the Warlords Season 2 shaman arena set.
Wild Combatant's Felshroud is the Warlords Season 2 warlock arena set.

The Wide Grin are a tribe of ferocious and intelligent murlocs who live on the Broken Isles. They wield some of the best equipment around and are know for fighting other tribes and attacking ships. There tactics involve javelins and melee attacks. They are led by several chieftains, two of which are Ipwoom and Ogloop. These murlocs are recognized by their red tattoos: a pair of slitted eyes over a big, toothy grin.
Wickerite Initiates are humans located in Autumnvale in Drustvar.

The Wickerites is a group of humans in Drustvar who have abandoned their homes and joined the cult worshipping the Wicker Man. They seem to have found an abandoned camp of the Heartsbane Coven, most notably a dormant wicker construct. Lord Autumnvale leads the cult and is apparently quite unsure how to "appease" the silent construct, trying random offerings and even admitting the cult can't read the Heartsbane scrolls. The Wickerites are seemingly disbanded when the Alliance adventurer kills Lord Autumnvale in the midst of a human sacrifice consisting of Edwin Maldus. The other members scatter upon seeing their leader fall.
The Wickerwoven Walkers were a quest reward from A New Order and Terminal Degree.
The Wickerwoven Cord was a quest reward from Big Gulls Won't Die and A Steady Ballast.
The Wicker Charm is provided as an objective for Charming the Lifeless.
The Wickerwoven Slippers were are a quest reward from Fighting With Fire. Its id was reused by Wickerwoven Shoes.
The Wickerwoven Sash is a quest reward from Hope They Can't Swim.
The Wickerwoven Bindings were a quest reward from Hold The Barricade! and Drustfall.
The Wickerwoven Vestments were a quest reward from Hope They Can't Swim.
The Wickerwoven Circlet was a quest reward from Hope They Can't Swim.
The Wickerwoven Mantle was a quest reward from Hope They Can't Swim.
The Wickerweave Cloak was a quest reward from Looking For One More during beta.
The Wickerwoven Leggings is a quest reward from The Final Effigy.
The Wickerwoven Pants are a quest reward from Rescue Rangers.
__NOTOC__ Wild Flour is sold by Cooking vendors in Kul Tiras and Zandalar.
Wild Dogs are mastiffs located at Freehold in Tiragarde Sound. Some are chasing Wandering Mousers.
Wicked Kegger took place at Mist's Edge in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns.
Wickerthorn Stompers drop from the Twin-hearted Construct in Tiragarde Sound.
Widowsister Contract is sold by The Widow in Dalaran for . Using it summons Widowsisters.
The Wickerwoven Shoulderpads were a quest reward from Lost in the Woods.
The Wickerwoven Wristwraps is a quest reward from Hold The Barricade!
Wickerbeast Mulcher drops from the Haywire Golem in Drustvar.
The Wicker Wraith is a shade companion rewarded from Family Battler.
Wickerbeasts are wicker beasts encountered by Horde champions in Drustvar.
__NOTOC__ Widow's Eyes are spiders located in Zanchul in Dazar'alor as part of the Zandalari troll recruitment questline.
__NOTOC__ Widow's Fangs are spiders located in Zanchul in Dazar'alor as part of the Zandalari troll recruitment questline.
Wide World of Quests is a World Quest achievement requiring players to complete 100 different World Quests found on Kul Tiras and Zandalar.
The Wicked Swarmer can be purchased from Wrathion in the Chamber of Heart for . To purchase this item, players must have completed We Have the Technology (achievement).
